title: goniophlebium bourretii
intro: Goniophlebium bourretii, commonly known as Bourret's Goniophlebium, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Goniophlebium bourretii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
